bio_text: Harshal Madnani is a teenage serial founder in the Web3 and fintech space, best known for founding Xade Finance at 16 to make DeFi accessible to everyday users, and later merging it with EdgeIn to scale to $20M in trading volume. He now leads Xybit, an online proprietary trading platform that funds talented traders globally. Holder of an O1 'extraordinary ability' visa at 18, he operates across New York, Dubai, and San Francisco.
